project.name: Softanza
project.pitch: The governed software platform of the AI age: a library and its Zig engine, a declared machine (Harobanda), a language of languages (Haro), and the projects built on them.

watch.name: Lookout
watch.title: Softanza AI Radar
watch.tagline: What changed in AI this week, and what it means for what we build in Softanza
watch.tagline_past: What changed in AI in week {week}, and what it meant for what we build in Softanza
watch.intro: Each week the radar reads the papers, releases, security findings and practices at their source, and shows where each one lands in Softanza: the machine (Harobanda), the language (Haro), the foundation (Softanza), and the projects built on them.

schedule.week: the latest ISO week that has ended

home.headline: AI changes every week. Softanza hears what concerns it the same week.
home.promise: Softanza AI Radar reads the week's papers, releases, security findings and practices at their source, judges each one from Softanza's point of view, and tells us, the Softanza team, what it means for us and what we should do about it: a check to run, a lesson to learn, or work proposed to the part it concerns.
home.why: Softanza is the governed software platform of the AI age, so almost every development in AI touches something it builds: its library and engine, its language Haro, its declared machine Harobanda, its interfaces, its intelligence layer. A finding that matters reaches the part it concerns within days, as work someone can act on, and what was learned is written down once, with its sources, where every session, project and reader finds it again.
need: Which of this week's developments touch Softanza, and which part of it
Where Softanza stands on each one, to adopt, learn from, correct, defend against, watch or decline
What each reader does next, whether developer, maintainer, learner or user
value: Each project of Softanza hears what concerns it, as a dated proposal it decides on
A record that lasts, every entry with its sources, its stance and its corrections
A signed feed any program can read, and a bar any site can show
The same watch for any project, from one file, lookout.yaml

readers.first: what happened and the work proposed to Softanza's projects come first

agent.goal: Keep Softanza, and the people who build, learn and work with it, ahead of what changes in AI: read each development at its source, say what it means for each part of Softanza, and propose the work it calls for.
in_scope: new projects, libraries, languages, runtimes, agents and tools
papers that change how we think about programming, learning, models or safety
features the labs and tool makers ship
practices of teams and companies with AI
security findings and fixes in models, agents, tool protocols and supply chains
regulation and standards that reach software like Softanza
ideas the owner brings, as a link or a sentence
out_of_scope: a private person's name, a client, or anything about either
anything said in a private conversation, unless its author asked for it to be published
a key, a token, a password, or a path on the machine that runs the watch
a source that was not read, or a vendor's figure presented as the project's own measurement

sources.name: arXiv cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.SE, cs.CR, cs.PL

stances.learn: it changes how we think, before it changes what we ship
stances.correct: the idea is right, and Softanza can do it better
stances.defend: a risk Softanza and its users must be protected from
stances.watch: too early; look again by the review date
stances.decline: considered and refused, with the reason

rules: read every development at its source before writing about it
write one plain sentence for each reader the entry concerns
place every entry on the map; the feed tool refuses a name the map does not list
date every proposal at each stage it reaches
public pages say what the project is and does, never what it lacks

proposals.through: Central, the session that coordinates Softanza's projects, one message per project
proposals.never: an edit in another project's repository
